failures.failure_reason: Initial pip install inside the model-local virtual environment failed under sandboxed network restrictions while resolving PyPI packages.
failures.mitigation: Escalated a controlled pip install into src/sure_eval/models/wespeaker/.venv and pinned the minimal SV dependency set.

failures.failure_reason: The local english checkpoint directory had avg_model.pt and the tarball, but config.yaml was missing, so the upstream loader tried to download again.
failures.mitigation: Extracted config.yaml from the existing model-local voxceleb_resnet221_LM.tar.gz archive and retried the same repo-native load path.

failures.failure_reason: torchaudio 2.1.2 could not open WAV fixtures until a usable audio backend was present in the environment.
failures.mitigation: Installed soundfile==0.13.1 into the same model-local virtual environment and retried inference without changing the callable path.
